Original: Korea Railroad Corporation (KORAIL), Metropolitan Railway Map, 2026-09-01 edition.
Source page: https://info.korail.com/info/contents.do?key=2950
PDF: https://info.korail.com/downloadContentsFile.do?key=2950&fileNo=1605
Retrieved: 2026-09-22.
Copyright remains with KORAIL. OriginalMap.pdf is preserved unmodified.

The source page displays KOGL Type 4 (attribution, noncommercial, no derivatives).
This is NOT a redistribution/commercial-use permission or a license grant.
The locally edited prototype map must not be represented as cleared for release.
Obtain the rights holder's permission before publishing/distributing this derivative.

Local edit: remove only intermediate stations skipped INSIDE the active delivery
routes, using SliceDeliveryCatalog plus the verified physical line sequences in
BuildMetroMap.py. Stations on untravelled lines, branches and directions remain.
A station used by any delivery is never removed merely because another skips it.
Existing rail runs exposed by removed symbols are joined only inside those symbol
footprints. All other source pixels are retained. This is a fictional game map,
not a travel guide.

Reproduction: install PyMuPDF==1.28.2, pypdf and Pillow, then run BuildMetroMap.py.
Run BuildRouteHighlights.py to rebuild all 13 cropped delivery overlays and their
catalog references. These contain only original map pixels with transparent masks;
the UI fades the background and decodes only the currently selected overlay.
The script reads the catalog relative to this directory, verifies the source SHA256,
and checks every RGB pixel outside deletion masks and every retained label/mark.
The trailing ~ prevents Unity from importing the source PDF/build script into the game.
